scope.method: read-only diskutil info, sw_vers, uname, and local manual-page inspection

proposed_first_action_recovery_gate.state: necessary_gate_only; not sufficient to prove mount history; not rehearsed or accepted
sequence: Record the clean shutdown to Recovery boot chain and every pre-Terminal authentication choice; abort if a Recovery Assistant or other step unlocks Data.
Before Disk Utility or any Data unlock/mount command, read only the exact Data APFS UUID, FileVault state, lock state, and mountpoint.
Require the UUID to match and FileVault enabled + Locked + no mountpoint; otherwise stop without unlocking or reading Data.
Inspect the earliest available boot-session disk arbitration/mount logs and explicitly account for missing or incomplete history; enumerate all Data aliases and snapshot mounts.

If independent history evidence supports the boundary, unlock interactively with -nomount, recheck identity and that no mount occurred, then explicitly mount readOnly and verify held-view identity/flags before reading.
proposed_first_action_recovery_gate.decision: Locked + unmounted is a necessary point-in-time check, but alone cannot exclude a previous unlock/mount/relock or another Data alias. If logs cannot establish earlier events, retain an explicit human-attested assumption and do not claim independently proven no-prior-writable-mount or qualified T.

independent_sol_review.decision: NO; the locked/no-mount check is necessary but not sufficient evidence of mount history.
additional_acceptance_evidence: Record the clean shutdown-to-first-probe sequence and every pre-Terminal authentication action; abort if Recovery Assistant or another step unlocks Data.
Inspect boot-session mount events and explicitly disposition log gaps.
Before unlock, verify exact Data UUID/group/device/lock state and enumerate all kernel mount entries and snapshot aliases.
After interactive unlockVolume -nomount, confirm Data is still unmounted; then mount explicitly read-only and recheck held-view identity and flags throughout capture.
independent_sol_review.limitation: If boot history cannot be established, no-prior-writable-mount remains an assumption; no T is qualified and NO-GO remains unchanged.

limitations: FileVault and lock state were observed only under the running host, not Recovery.
The local manual describes this online OS build; Recovery may ship a different tool/runtime version.
No evidence has been collected about automatic Recovery unlock or mount behavior.
No writable-mount-history claim, Data T, capture, restore, or erase readiness is established.
